config.declaration: Predeclared F1 characterization of the unchanged upwind/Euler solver. No application-wide accuracy qualification or solver correction. Existing A9 gates/configurations remain unchanged.
notes: Characterization completion is distinct from accuracy qualification. No new product accuracy threshold is invented.
The outlet flux uses the last cell average as a face approximation. Compare it separately with the continuum last-cell average and point outlet.
First upward threshold crossings use sampled brackets, not unqualified interpolated timestamps. Repeated crossings and missing discharge are explicit.
Decimation selects original samples from one run and never changes its integration trajectory.
Scheduled inlet has no semidiscrete reference in this batch; its refinement remains coupled space/time.
Reference roundoff estimates and cross-checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval enclosures.

reference.scope: Floating-point cross-check/roundoff scale; not a formal enclosure

outlet.scope: Native peak is sampled; reference peak is characteristic supremum; point/last-cell errors are separate

limitations: No application-wide field, peak, outlet or threshold accuracy qualification is claimed.
Scheduled-inlet refinement remains coupled space/time; no semidiscrete inlet oracle is supplied.
Reference uncertainty is an observed disagreement/roundoff estimate, not a formal enclosure.
Saved outlet peaks and crossing brackets do not resolve unsaved native states.
The legacy coarse failure and refined 0.40191 mg/L front limitation retain their original scope.
